A gas explosion at an NNPC filling station near Savannah Bus Stop, Command, Ipaja, Lagos State, on Monday sparked a fire, raising concerns among residents. The fire reportedly spread to nearby buildings, while emergency responders were said to have arrived at the scene. A social media user, @Taghandler, disclosed the incident in a post on X on Monday, saying he received a distress call from his younger brother about the fire at the filling station and a nearby school. Another account of the incident said the cause of the explosion and the extent of the damage had yet to be confirmed. As of the time of filing this report, there was no official confirmation of casualties or the cause of the explosion.
